title: feat(kanban): the board's own view settings, lane header create and menu, and a lane statistic
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbCxiFE11rsKwyNffJZKYqJs)_

repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jRKaa4gJCNNF5QMd8t

Fixes #36370

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: carried by #36422

Claim: 7076741092

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：看板视图的「视图设置」换成看板自己的一套——分列字段、显示哪几列（「5 / 7」，可拖动排序、可隐藏）、卡片上显示的字段（拖动排序、隐藏、「+ 添加字段」）、「显示字段名」「隐藏空字段」两个开关、列底统计（无 / 计数 / 数字字段求和或平均）；表格的「显示的列 / 分组 / 行高 / 行颜色」在看板上不再出现。每列表头加「+」（新建并预填该列的值，空列另有「+ 新建」行）和「⋯」（折叠这一列、隐藏这一列）。
- 规则：除折叠外，所有改动沿用 #35955 的草稿规则——立即生效、出现「放弃 / 保存」、保存前不写任何东西；折叠只记在本浏览器（localStorage，键为 `objectui:kanban-lanes-collapsed:<对象>:<视图 id>`，不含用户，同一浏览器里的账号共用）。隐藏一列等于在「显示哪几列」里取消勾选。
- 协议：`KanbanConfig` 加三个可选键 `summary`（列底统计，优先于 `summarizeField`，`{type:'none'}` 表示不显示）、`showFieldLabels`、`hideEmptyFields`（两者缺省为 true，即现在的卡片），均无 spec 默认值，旧视图不变；这是本 PR 最后两个提交，L2 看 schema 面。另修 Console 一直丢掉 `kanban.lanes` 的转发（#28211 的列顺序在 Console 上从未生效）。
- 未做：卡片底部图标开关（没有每张卡的评论/附件计数，也没有进入阶段的时间戳，已另立 #36423）；新增列选项、卡片布局、Studio、手机看板不在本卡范围。

## What changes

**1. The board's own 视图设置 (`plugin-list`).** `ViewSettingsPopover` takes a `kanban` prop (`ViewSettingsKanban`); `ListView` builds it on a board, and the panel then draws, in place of the table's columns, Group, Row height and Row colour:

| Row | What it writes |
|---|---|
| 分列字段 (lane field) | `groupByField`, from the #36204 range (select, radio, boolean, toggle, user, lookup, master_detail, tree; single-valued), and drops `lanes` with it |
| 显示哪几列 `5 / 7` | `lanes`: hide, show (at the end), drag to reorder, 「显示全部」; the last shown lane has no eye; `undefined` when the list is every option in its own order |
| 卡片上显示的字段 | `columns`: drag, hide in place, 「+ 添加字段」 adds at the end |
| 显示字段名 / 隐藏空字段 | `showFieldLabels` / `hideEmptyFields`: `false` when turned off, absent when on |
| 列底统计 | `summary`: none, count, sum or avg of a number/currency/percent/integer field; None over a view with `summarizeField` writes `{ type: 'none' }` |

`ListView` gains `onKanbanChange(patch)`; `null` in a patch means the key leaves the block. The phone settings sheet shares `ViewSettingsContent`, so it shows the same board rows. `FieldList` gains `hiddenTitle` and `typeIcons` so the lanes list reads 「隐藏的列」 and draws no field-type icon.

**2. Lane header 「+」 and 「⋯」 (`plugin-kanban`).** `ObjectKanban` takes the host's `laneMenu` request (`KanbanLaneMenuRequest`: `collapseKey`, `onHideLane`, `onCreateInLane`), relayed to `KanbanImpl` over a package-private context (the `KanbanColumnSummary` pattern; never a node key). Without it no header draws either control. 「+」 reports its lane; an empty lane also gets a 「+ 新建」 row. 「⋯」 holds 折叠这一列 / 展开这一列 and 隐藏这一列; the `Uncategorized` lane offers collapse only. Collapse is kept per browser under `objectui:kanban-lanes-collapsed:<collapseKey>` (`ListView` passes `<object>:<view id>`), written only after a user toggle; a collapsed lane's heading opens it again, and an open lane keeps its bare title. `ListView` wires create as `onEdit({ [laneField]: value })`, the seeded-record create the calendar already uses (objectui#12291), and hide as unticking the lane (at least one lane stays).

**3. The lane statistic and the card toggles (`plugin-kanban`).** `summary` draws at each lane's foot (`[data-kanban-lane-statistic]`, 「计数 2」, 「合计 · 金额 40」) and replaces the `summarizeField` header total; `{ type: 'none' }` draws neither. `laneStatistic(cards, field, type)` counts, sums, averages, takes min/max over numeric values, `null` over none. A windowed lane reads `+`. `showFieldLabels: false` draws card values without their names (`KanbanCardDisplayContext`); `hideEmptyFields: false` keeps an empty field's line with a dash. Without the keys, boards draw as before.

**4. The draft (`app-shell`).** The board's changes are a list-draft part: `ListDraft.kanban` holds only the changed keys (`nextKanbanDraft` drops a key changed back to the view's own; `null` = removed). `objectViewListRenderer` lays it over the view's block (`layKanbanDraft`) and wires `onKanbanChange`; `ObjectView` hands it to Save as `display.kanban`, and `layListStateOverView` lays it over the stored block, so Save to this view / Save as personal view write it and Discard drops it. `ListDraftActions` lists the part as 「看板设置」.

**5. In-surface fix: the Console relays `kanban.lanes` (#28211).** `kanbanViewOptions` relayed the lane field, title, card fields and `summarizeField` but never `lanes`, so a Console board drew every option whatever the view declared. It now relays `lanes` (a non-empty array) and the three new keys, each only when declared. Pinned in `kanbanDraft-36370.test.ts` (d).

**6. Spec widening (final commits).** `KanbanConfigSchema` gains `summary: ColumnSummaryConfigSchema.optional()`, `showFieldLabels: z.boolean().optional()`, `hideEmptyFields: z.boolean().optional()`, no defaults. Regenerated: `authorable-surface/ui.json`, `content/docs/references/{ui/view,api/protocol,data/object}.mdx`. Liveness: the `kanban` row of `liveness/view.json` names the three keys' read points.

## Left out (stated, per the seat)

- **Card footer icons toggle**: no per-board data — a board has no per-card comment or attachment count, and no stage-entered timestamp. Carried by #36423.
- `plugin-view`'s `ObjectView#generateViewSchema` (the other `object-kanban` producer) does not relay the three new keys; the Console path is `ListView`.

## Tests

- `plugin-kanban/src/ObjectKanban.laneMenu-36370.test.tsx` (4): no controls without `laneMenu`; 「+」 and the empty-lane row report their lane, an open lane's heading is no disclosure; 「Hide column」 reports its lane, `Uncategorized` offers collapse only; collapse persists under the host key, reopens from the heading, another key is unaffected.
- `plugin-kanban/src/ObjectKanban.laneStatistic-36370.test.tsx` (6): count, sum (in place of the header total), avg, none (also over `summarizeField`), the two toggles and their defaults; `laneStatistic` units.
- `plugin-list/src/__tests__/ViewSettingsPopover.kanban-36370.test.tsx` (6): the board rows and none of the table's; lane field pick; lanes hide/show/keep-last, 「Hidden columns」 heading, no type icon; card fields hide/add; toggles and statistic writes; the zh pack names every row.
- `app-shell/src/views/kanbanDraft-36370.test.ts` (7): draft keeps changed keys and drops ones changed back; lay with `null`; Save lays the draft into a body `ListViewSchema` accepts; CONTROL without a draft; the `kanbanViewOptions` relay and its omissions.
- Suites run locally: `plugin-kanban` 83 files / 545 tests, `plugin-list` 185 / 2017, `@object-ui/types` 389 / 10501, spec `src/ui/view*` 37 / 1505, and the 392 `app-shell` test files naming kanban, the list draft, personal views or the relay (all green after the fix below), `@object-ui/i18n` 106 / 1978, and `ui/scripts` 174 / 5127. Targeted gates: `dispatch-gates --ran` 118 derived, 117 run green, 1 NOT MEASURED (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, exit 3 on its prerequisite, left to CI); `overlap-check` clean against main and 15 open PRs. Found and fixed on the way: a hook placed after `ObjectKanban`'s error early return (errorClears-10663), and an always-on heading disclosure that moved `listKanbanEveryRecord-12619`'s badge locator.

## Verification

Screenshots (zh, a `ListView` board over a mock data source in a temporary Console Vite entry, removed before commit) are in the project folder `issue-36370/`, not on GitHub: `settings.png` (the board's 视图设置 first level), `settings-lanes.png` (显示哪几列, 「隐藏的列」), `settings-summary.png` (列底统计), `lane-menu.png` (「⋯」 on 谈判), `board-sum-nolabels.png` (合计 · 金额 at each lane's foot, 显示字段名 off). Lane 「+」 on 谈判 opened the create form seeded `{"stage":"negotiation"}`.

NOT MEASURED live: the Sales pipeline app, the Discard/Save round trip against a real backend, and a self-built app; the draft and Save path is covered by the unit pins above.
